name: SQL Injection
rationale: The search q parameter is interpolated into SQL. Independent bounded replay returned 1 normal, 12 true-comparison, and 0 false-comparison results. ZAP detected it with Medium confidence after increasing the general SQL rule to HIGH. No writes, credential extraction, or code execution were demonstrated.

name: Missing Anti-clickjacking Header
rationale: HTML responses omit CSP frame-ancestors and X-Frame-Options. Replay confirmed absent headers; a separate loopback fixture successfully embedded the catalogue. This confirms the intentional A05 framing condition, not a completed clickjacking attack.

name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
rationale: The CSP header is absent on HTML and error responses, consistent with the deliberately omitted-header configuration. This overlaps the A05 framing finding and records a broader hardening omission; absent CSP alone does not establish XSS.

name: Vulnerable JS Library
rationale: The catalogue loads local jQuery 3.4.1, an affected component covered by CVE-2020-11022, patched in 3.5.0. Category filtering and AJAX cart updates exercise the library. Untrusted HTML reaching affected DOM methods and browser exploitation were not demonstrated.

name: Server Leaks Version Information via "Server" HTTP Response Header Field
rationale: The local Werkzeug development server returns a Server banner identifying Werkzeug 3.1.9 and Python 3.14.3. This is an additional environment fingerprinting observation, not a demonstrated vulnerable-server exploit.

name: X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing
rationale: The nosniff header is absent on HTML and local assets, within the deliberately omitted-header configuration. This is an additional header-hardening observation; MIME confusion exploitation was not demonstrated.

name: User Controllable HTML Element Attribute (Potential XSS)
rationale: Low-confidence reflection hotspots comprise eight category records and one search record. Source review finds category selection restricted to existing options and search text autoescaped in a quoted input value. No executable sink or context-break reproduction was established. Retain as an unresolved hotspot with benign reviewed reflection; do not count as confirmed XSS or claim all possible XSS ruled out.

name: Session Management Response Identified
rationale: The scanner identified the application's intended session cookie. This is confirmed informational session metadata, not a vulnerability or proof of session compromise. Cookie flags, authentication transitions, and CSRF were checked separately.

name: Authentication Request Identified
rationale: The scanner recognized normal local login requests used for the authorized assessment. This is confirmed informational authentication metadata, not a vulnerability. Private sessions and appropriate customer/admin responses were independently verified.

name: Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments
rationale: The match is the public jQuery implementation keyword username in its XHR configuration, rather than an application credential or private comment. It is a false positive as sensitive disclosure. The outdated-library finding is recorded separately.
